messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick sync: we need a compact, low-cardinality signal for why a request fell back (latency / cost / region / tier). Goals: cheap on hot path, human-decodable in console, and stable over rollouts.

Rafael Gomez: Use a tiny reason enum emitted only on fallback. No freeform text in metrics. Keep labels to route_id + reason + region.

Noah Patel: Agreed. Also don't attach tenant ids to the metric; link to a sampled trace if deeper context is needed.

Ellen Park: Compiler can bake a 1-byte reason_code per rule. Runtime just plucks it from the eval result. Adds ~<1us p50 in my microbench.

Aisha Khan: Nice. What about mappings/versions so the console can decode older codes?

Rafael Gomez: Include bundle_id (short hash) in the decision when reason != NONE. Console uses bundle to map code->label. Bundle optional on happy path.

Noah Patel: Config toggle for exposing binding hints in UI/logs. Default: off. Hints available to ops roles only.

agent-ci: ci:8200000020 policy-telemetry-tests (n=40) - PASS. report: http://ci/reports/8200000020

Ellen Park: Tests: I'll add an integration that asserts no metric emission on happy path and correct bundle attachment on fallback.

Aisha Khan: Action items: Rafael drafts bundle versioning notes, Ellen lands compiler change, Noah updates metrics docs + playbook. Target EOB next Wed. I'll file an RFC follow-up doc.
